C0464.title: Man Detained in Mao County, Sichuan for Defrauding Over 20,000 Yuan Using Fake Transfer Screenshots
C0464.summary: The case was reported and investigated in February 2024. Since early 2023, a man surnamed Yu in Mao County, Sichuan, had repeatedly used delayed mobile banking transfers as a pretext and fabricated fake transaction screenshots to defraud multiple victims, involving more than 20,000 yuan. Yu has been placed under criminal detention.
